annotations.title: Brainstorm scored ideas for a topic

description: Brainstorm ideas for a topic, goal, problem or question, each scored 1-10 on three criteria that fit the kind of brainstorm (for business ideas: market size, ease to start, profit potential; for problem solving: impact, feasibility, cost to implement) with an overall score, sorted best first. depth 2 also grows 3 sub-ideas under each of the top 3. Returns a map_url that opens the result as an interactive bubble map on stormap.ai, where a person can keep growing, re-scoring and sharing it. Scores are quick model estimates for sorting, not research.

depth.description: 1 (default) or 2 to also grow sub-ideas under the top 3.

mode.description: Kind of brainstorm; sets the scoring criteria (default general). breakdown splits the topic into exhaustive, non-overlapping parts with no scores.

steer.description: Optional constraint, e.g. "cheap, no hardware", "for beginners".

topic.description: What to brainstorm, e.g. "side hustles for engineers", "reduce factory scrap rate", "YouTube channel about home cooking".
